answers.evidence:
**Unit tests — 9/9 pass** (`go test -count=1 ./...`), covering:

| Test | Covers |
|---|---|
| `TestApplyStartupValidations_DisablesCompressionOnDeepSeek` | C-GAP-002 correction: compression off + warning explaining missing embeddings endpoint |
| `TestApplyStartupValidations_KeepsCompressionOnEmbeddingBackend` | OpenAI backend → compression stays on, no compression warning (no false positive) |
| `TestApplyStartupValidations_RespectsExplicitDisable` | User-disabled compression is never re-enabled / re-warned |
| `TestApplyStartupValidations_DeepSeekNonDefaultEmbeddingModelKeepsCompression` | Non-default model is not touched (only the exact default triggers correction) |
| `TestApplyStartupValidations_WarnsOnMissingAPIKey` | C-GAP-003: warn when key empty; no warning when set |
| `TestRunServer_LogsWarningsViaSlogWarn` | Both warnings emitted at `level=WARN` |
| `TestRunServer_DoesNotStartCompressionWorkerWhenDisabled` | Worker stub not invoked after correction; config mutated |
| `TestRunServer_StartsCompressionWorkerWhenSupported` | Worker starts on embeddings-capable backend |
| `TestCLIFlagIsDbUrl` | C-GAP-001: `--db-url` registered and parses; legacy `--db` absent |

**Live `make dev` run** (default DeepSeek config, `LLM_API_KEY` unset) — WARNs printed, compression worker NOT started, exit 0:

```
level=WARN msg="startup validation" detail="compression disabled: backend \"deepseek\" has no embeddings endpoint for model \"text-embedding-3-small\"; ..."
level=WARN msg="startup validation" detail="LLM API key is not set: LLM requests will fail at runtime (set LLM_API_KEY or pass --llm-api-key)"
level=INFO msg="compression worker not started (compression disabled)"
```

Edge cases exercised in live runs:
- **Env key present** (this machine has `LLM_API_KEY` set): only the compression WARN prints — the missing-key warning is correctly suppressed, proving no false positives.
- **`make dev-openai`**: no compression WARN, `compression worker started` — compression only disabled where it would actually fail.

**Guard script — `guard PASS 5/5`** (`make guard`, exit 0): (1) Makefile recipes use `$(BIN) --db-url`, no `$(BIN) --db `; (2) `config.ApplyStartupValidations` exported; (3)–(5) behavioral checks via the unit tests above. One interim guard failure was a regex artifact (it matched the comment "CLI has no --db flag"); fixed by scoping check #1 to recipe lines with `grep -F` on `$(BIN)`.
